title: 第9章 消失的女妖尸体第10章 银须虎
content_zh:
张楚决定，无论如何，都要帮童青山突破六洞命井的限制。
于是，张楚沉吟道：“修炼一途，是不断突破自身枷锁的一条路。”
“有时候，自身的力量到了极限，就需要从外界补充力量，精气，甚至各种宝物进行突破。”
“需要药材吗？”童青山顿时问。
张楚点头：“没错。”
紧接着张楚沉吟道：“龙鳞兰，还记得那株宝药么？”
童青山一听这个名字，顿时瞪大了眼睛：“先生，是大角蟒守护的那株药吧？您以前叮嘱过我，要留意它，我早就记住了。”
张楚点头：“就是它！”
在妖墟，各种药的药性是不同的。
有些药，采摘之后，经过一定的处理，可以长久保存，这种便可以提前采摘来备用。
但也有一些药，采摘之后，药性很快就会流失掉。
对这种药性流失很快的药，张楚要求童青山记录下药草的地点。
这龙鳞兰，便是药性流失极快的宝药。
但凡宝药，必有守在它附近的怪物或者大妖。
守护龙鳞兰的，就是一条怪蟒。
这时候童青山说道：“那条大角蟒很恐怖，身子比大象还粗，平日里盘在芒砀山的山头，周围所有的野物都不敢鸣叫，它是这一片大山的王。”
张楚则看向了小村外：“这几天，外面暂时平静了一些，我们可以避开外来人或者大妖的战斗，试试能不能取到龙鳞兰。”
“可以出去吗？”童青山欣喜。
这一个多月，猎人队都憋在小村里，不断的修炼，服药，早就憋坏了。
只是，猎人队都很听张楚和老村长的话，他们不放话，没人敢外出。

现在听张楚说出去采药，童青山当然高兴。
张楚则轻声道：“也要检验一下你的修炼成果了。”
整整准备了两天，才决定出发。
老枣树前，老村长认真的祈祷，希望老枣树保佑大家，能平安归来。
“青山，这是先生第一次外出，无论发生什么，都要保护好先生，知道吗？”老村长已经叮嘱了不下十遍。
这一次，张楚也要跟随猎人队出去。
原本，大家都不同意，生怕张楚出现意外。
但是，龙鳞兰这味药很特别，除非张楚亲自去指点着摘取，否则，其他人去了，非出错不可。
龙鳞兰可以入药的部分，是叶子。
它拥有二十三片叶子，每一片叶子形态，颜色各不相同，而且还交替变幻，神秘莫测。
这二十三片叶子，只有一片叶可入药。
古怪的是，每一个时辰，能入药的叶子不同，例如午时，能入药的叶片是针状，白色。
而到了未时，能入药的叶片则是柳叶形，金黄色。
content_en:
Zhang Chu decided that no matter what, he would help Tong Qingshan break through the restrictions of the six-hole life well.
Therefore, Zhang Chu muttered: "Cultivation is a way to constantly break through one's own shackles."
"Sometimes, when your own strength reaches its limit, you need to supplement your strength, energy, and even various treasures from the outside world to make a breakthrough."
"Do you need any medicinal materials?" Tong Qingshan asked immediately.
Zhang Chu nodded: "That's right."
Then Zhang Chu muttered: "Dragon Scale Orchid, do you still remember that precious medicine?"
When Tong Qingshan heard the name, his eyes widened immediately: "Sir, is it the medicine plant guarded by the horned python? You told me before to pay attention to it, and I have already remembered it."
Zhang Chu nodded: "That's it!"
In Yaoxu, various medicines have different medicinal properties.
Some medicines can be stored for a long time after being processed for a long time after being picked. This kind of medicine can be picked in advance for later use.
But there are also some medicines whose medicinal properties will be lost quickly after being picked.
For this kind of medicine that loses its medicinal properties very quickly, Zhang Chu asked Tong Qingshan to record the location of the medicinal herbs.
This Dragon Scale Orchid is a precious medicine that loses its medicinal properties very quickly.
As long as there is a treasure medicine, there must be a monster or a big demon guarding it.
The one guarding the Dragon Scale Orchid is a strange python.
At this time, Tong Qingshan said: "That big horned python is very scary. Its body is thicker than an elephant. It usually hangs on the top of Mangdang Mountain. All the wild animals around it dare not scream. It is the king of this mountain."
Zhang Chu looked outside the small village: "In the past few days, the outside has been calmer for the time being. We can avoid the battles of outsiders or big monsters and try to get the Dragon Scale Orchid."
"Can I go out?" Tong Qingshan was delighted.
For more than a month, the hunter team has been suffocating in the small village. They have been practicing and taking medicine, and they have long been exhausted.
However, the hunting team listened to Zhang Chu and the old village chief. They kept quiet and no one dared to go out.
Now of course Tong Qingshan is happy to hear Zhang Chu say that he went out to collect medicine.
Zhang Chuze said softly: "It's time to test your cultivation results."
It took two days of preparation before I decided to set off.
In front of the old jujube tree, the old village chief prayed seriously, hoping that the old jujube tree would bless everyone and bring them back safely.
"Qingshan, this is your first time out. No matter what happens, you must protect your husband, you know?" The old village chief has warned him no less than ten times.
This time, Zhang Chu will also go out with the hunter team.
Originally, everyone disagreed, fearing that something might happen to Zhang Chu.
However, Dragon Scale Orchid is a very special medicine. Unless Zhang Chu personally guides and picks it, other people will make mistakes.
The part of the dragon scale orchid that can be used as medicine is the leaves.
It has twenty-three leaves, each with a different shape and color, and they change alternately and mysteriously.
Of these twenty-three leaves, only one leaf can be used as medicine.
The strange thing is that the leaves that can be used as medicine are different at each hour. For example, at noon, the leaves that can be used as medicine are needle-shaped and white.
At the end of the year, the leaves that can be used as medicine are willow leaf-shaped and golden yellow.
